        .bind("deviceId", sample.deviceId())
        .bind("metric", sample.metric())
        .bind("tDevice", toOffset(sample.tDeviceEpochMs()))
        .bind("value", sample.value())
        .bind("status", toDbStatus(sample.validationStatus()))
        .bind("tIngress", toOffset(sample.tIngressEpochMs()))
        .fetch()
        .rowsUpdated()
        .map(updated -> updated > 0);
members: public Mono<Void> appendRevision(TelemetrySample revision) { return client.sql("INSERT INTO telemetry_event_log.telemetry_record_revisions (device_id, metric, t_device, value, reason, t_revised) VALUES (:deviceId, :metric, :tDevice, :value, :reason, :tRevised)").bind("deviceId", revision.deviceId()).bind("metric", revision.metric()).bind("tDevice", toOffset(revision.tDeviceEpochMs())).bind("value", revision.value()).bind("reason", "LATE_ARRIVAL").bind("tRevised", toOffset(revision.tIngressEpochMs())).fetch().rowsUpdated().then(); }

public Flux<TelemetrySample> findByDeviceAndRange(String deviceId, long fromEpochMs, long toEpochMs) { return client.sql("SELECT device_id, metric, t_device, value, validation_status, t_ingress FROM telemetry_event_log.telemetry_records WHERE device_id = :deviceId AND t_device >= :from AND t_device <= :to ORDER BY t_device ASC").bind("deviceId", deviceId).bind("from", toOffset(fromEpochMs)).bind("to", toOffset(toEpochMs)).map(row -> new TelemetrySample(row.get("device_id", String.class), row.get("metric", String.class), row.get("t_device", OffsetDateTime.class).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), row.get("value", Double.class), row.get("t_ingress", OffsetDateTime.class).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), fromDbStatus(row.get("validation_status", String.class)))).all(); }
private static OffsetDateTime toOffset(long epochMs) { return OffsetDateTime.ofInstant(Instant.ofEpochMilli(epochMs), ZoneOffset.UTC); }
private static String toDbStatus(String status) { return TelemetrySample.VALIDATION_FAILED.equals(status) ? "INVALID" : status; }
private static String fromDbStatus(String status) { return "INVALID".equals(status) ? TelemetrySample.VALIDATION_FAILED : status; }
